scope: Complete Sugarscape case study, section4.3 and Figures6/11; separate Boids/Circles framework studies excluded as originally declared.
criterion: Faithful execution and validation of the paper-linked released method with investigated discrepancies. Exact historical numerical agreement is not required.

claims.requirement: Pinned released benchmark and engine, full unmodified experiment, declared replacement hardware.
claims.finding: H100/CUDA11.8/GCC11.4 differs from archived V100/CUDA11.0/GCC9.3; no historical absolute-time claim.

claims.requirement: All84 original conditions and complete requested step counts.
claims.finding: Fresh native audit: exit0,84conditions,6600step records,162resolution rows; no shortened substitute.

claims.requirement: Recompute all native population and timing means.
claims.finding: All132 aggregate means checked under recorded decimal-rounding bounds.

claims.requirement: Reconstruct population across original conditions and compare the archive.
claims.finding: All6600 population records match; same source-defined occupied-only metric, not total surviving agents.

claims.requirement: Reconstruct stored resolution curves and retain measurement qualifications.
claims.finding: All162rows match; unused first bin, off-by-one labels, integer truncation and unobserved forced-exit round remain explicit. These curves cannot prove every agent resolved.

claims.requirement: Reconstruct timing scaling with hardware and seed uncertainty disclosed.
claims.finding: All16widths/3seeds used; observed seed ranges, not confidence intervals. Linear fits descriptive; no cross-hardware speedup or absolute-time equivalence.

claims.requirement: Reconstruct initial,first,fiftieth states and compare fixed-grid image classes.
claims.finding: All3 requested states compared; images differ. Complete native state accounting and Clang/RNG/frame controls investigate causes without selecting a match. Historical image executable remains unknown.

claims.requirement: Compare dependency graph, messages, mapping and exit behavior.
claims.finding: Graph matches. Native unresolved agents contradict an unconditional all-resolved interpretation; counter reset controls isolate carryover in the observed condition.

claims.requirement: Audit collisions,identities,resource accounting,transfers and resolution completion.
claims.finding: 101snapshots have unique identities/positions; independent accounting validates881753 post-step records. Released transfer omission,diagonal moves and unresolved statuses are observed, not inferred from plot mismatch.

claims.requirement: Investigate implementation differences with declared native controls.
claims.finding: Five rule controls,four counter controls,nine initializer controls retain exact repeated baselines. Nine initializer audits cover5216793records and589824cells with independent R landscapes. Alternatives are diagnostics,not substituted full-grid runs.

claims.requirement: Retain contradictory parameter and update-order interpretations.
claims.finding: Figure6 agrees with metabolism-first source; section4.3 describes movement-first. No single corrected interpretation or best-fitting variant is asserted.

interpretation: Completed mixed replication study: full released numerical workflow reproduces; original source violates several stated model properties; historical illustrations and absolute timings remain qualified. This is not a faithful implementation of every contradictory prose specification or a corrected full-grid benchmark.
remaining_qualifications: Historical image executable,compiler and random-stream provenance remain unknown.
Different GPU/toolchain prevents historical absolute-time equivalence.
Observed destinations condition independent state accounting; it is not an independent engine or conflict-winner replay.
Corrected-rule controls cover one seed/condition and do not establish corrected full-grid population/scaling results.
Prose,diagram and parameter descriptions do not identify a unique corrected model.
completion_reason: All original Sugarscape protocol deliverables have execution,analysis and discrepancy evidence. Remaining uncertainties limit interpretation; requiring exact pictures or a chosen correction would replace the accepted method-reproduction criterion.
